title: No `Core\Session` member returns the session id a CSRF token is issued for.
text: Under a keyed CSRF door a token issued for no session is refused, and a bare `Core\Session::start` sends no cookie until the session is first written. So a page that renders a token for a visitor with no session must write the session first, and no member returns the id to issue the token for. Closing it is that member, or `Core\Csrf::issue` taking the started session, and the taught login pages using it.
